messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency breach on /v1/generate (model: gptx-3b-q8) in eu-west. SLO p99=300ms -> current p99=1.2s over last 3m. PagerDuty incident: PD-5654 fired
pagerduty: Pager PD-5654 paged Sam H (oncall). Please acknowledge to start incident coordination.
Sam H: acked. jumping in. pinging runtime + infra. what's the impact? any customer-facing errors?
Jia L: seeing p95 ~ 420ms, p99 ~ 1.2s, error rate stable. traces show KV-cache eviction spikes and long GPU GC on sidecars. likely KV-cache thrash after recent rollout.
Marcus K: I can check autoscaler + pods. no recent infra deploys. node CPU fine, GPU mem pressure in two pods (pod-az1-rt-12, pod-az2-rt-09).
Sam H: ok let's triage. Jia, can you roll traffic to fallback variant (gptx-3b-q4) for the hot routes? quick link to routing: https://console/redwood/routing
Jia L: initiating canary shift: routing tool -> set fallback policy for /v1/generate routes to variant q4 at 25%.
ops-bot: Routing change applied: 25% -> gptx-3b-q4. Monitor for 1m.
Elaine R: customer impact check: top client shows increased latency but no 5xxs. spike correlating with big batch requests from partner-acme at 12:10 UTC.
Sam H: good. Marcus can you evict KV cache entries on oa-sidecars to reduce eviction storms? suggest rolling restart on the worst pods.
Marcus K: running: kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime-sidecar -l az=eu-west-1a --grace-period=30
Marcus K: also increasing qps throttling at edge for partner-acme from 1k/s -> 600/s to smooth bursts.
Sam H: command for throttling: 
```
apictl rate-limit update --client partner-acme --limit 600
```
Jia L: after routing change + restart, p99 dropped to ~480ms within 45s. still unstable but much better.
Sam H: nice. continue rolling routing to 50% to q4. ops-bot: Routing change applied: 50% -> gptx-3b-q4.
Elaine R: monitoring customer dashboards, partner-acme sees degraded latency but no errors. Ops notified.
Marcus K: autoscaler logs show scale up events suppressed by burst-protection; I'm temporarily disabling burst-protection to allow pod spin-up.
Marcus K: `kubectl patch cm autoscaler-config -p '{"burst_protection":false}'`
Sam H: caution on removing protection. what's expected spin-up time? 
Jia L: ~30-45s for new replicas to become ready. we'll watch for cold start impact but routing to q4 reduces seq len.
PagerDuty: Reminder: please update PD incident with mitigation steps and ETA. Next escalation in 12m if not stable.
Sam H: updating incident. summary: p99 spike due to KV-cache thrash on runtime sidecars, mitigated by routing 50% to q4 variant, sidecar restarts, and throttle for partner-acme. ETA for full rollback of alert: 30m pending stabilization.
Elaine R: I'll keep customer comms on standby; no P1 notification yet.
Jia L: current metrics: p95=320ms, p99=460ms, error rate unchanged. continuing to observe.
Sam H: setting handoff in 25m unless resolved. @oncall-next please be ready to bridge. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Incident note added to PD-5654: routing fallback, sidecar restarts, throttling applied.
Sam H: removing myself from immediate watch, will stay reachable. handing to Elaine for customer checks and Marcus for infra follow-up. Elaine, Marcus, Jia are you taking the 25m handoff?
Elaine R: taking customer-facing handoff. I'll monitor dashboards and update PD.
Marcus K: taking infra follow-up. will track autoscaler and pod readiness.
Jia L: runtime follow-up acknowledged. will verify KV-cache warmup and apply hotfix if recurrence.
Sam H: thanks all. leaving channel; if p99 >700ms or errors spike -> page PD-escalation. :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Status update: alert status -> mitigated (p99 within SLO). Monitoring for 10m.
PagerDuty: PD-5654 acknowledged by Sam H, reassigned to Elaine R for monitoring.
Elaine R: confirmed stable after 12m. moving to post-incident review tomorrow. handing over to next oncall in 25m.
